name: Brandung
prior: Tom Mudd, Gutter Synthesis (2017/18): 'a discrete implementation of the damped, forced Duffing oscillator' feeding resonator banks, the download uses 'an interrelated set of eight Duffing oscillators and associated filter banks'; standalone Mac/Win + Max, CD/software at Cafe OTO (VS: cycling74.com/projects/gutter-synthesis, tommudd.bandcamp.com/album/gutter-synthesis, cafeoto.co.uk shop) = the forced Duffing as a playable instrument, desktop, no pitch field. Barrel Synth (Josh Mitchell, CCRMA 220a, 2022): browser instrument 'heavily related to Tom Mudd's Gutter Synthesis', a chaotic oscillator with comb-filter feedback 'which constrains the sound toward a recognizable pitch', slider-matrix UI (VS: ccrma.stanford.edu/~jomitch/220a/fp) = chaos + pitch constraint in a browser, not a voice. iDDY (Aalborg thesis 2024): Duffing oscillator + 8-band filterbank under capacitive touch (VS: projekter.aau.dk). Joranalogue Orbit 3 (Eurorack): analogue double-scroll chaos oscillator, 2.4 mHz-22 kHz, temperature-compensated 1 V/oct, 'some (bi)stable regions in addition to chaotic ones' (VS: orbit-3 manual, reverb.com, rubadub.co.uk) = pitched chaos oscillator in hardware. Attrattore (Creature from the Black, free Windows VST3): subtractive synth whose two oscillators are 36 chaotic attractors (Lorenz, Roessler, Chua...) integrated in real time, drone mode (VS: kvraudio.com/product/attrattore-by-creature-from-the-black); Pura Belia Fragua (2026): polyphonic plugin 'driven by complex chaos' (VS: synthanatomy.com 2026/08). HetrickCV 1-/2-/3-Op Chaos, Gingerbread, Feedback Sine Chaos, Chaotic Attractors = 'audio and modulation chaos generators' in VCV Rack (VS: library.vcvrack.com/HetrickCV). Max gen~ Duffing patch (Giles/Wakefield; VS: cycling74 forum patchShare). Research base: SC chaos UGens, Csound chuap, Benjolin/Rungler, Rizzuti DAFx 2025 chaos as exciter (R: synthesis.md 2.6); Mudd's 'edge-like interaction' studies (R: musicians.md P1). iOS: only attractor visualisers (Chaos Studies, Strangely Attractive; VS: apps.apple.com), no playable chaos app found. Not found: a touch/pitch-field voice in which the note is the forcing, the bifurcation parameter sits under the finger and the subharmonic states are the play.
costNotes: Measured here (M: research/bench/duffing_check.js, Node 22 x64): semi-implicit Euler, 2 substeps, table cosine = 30.6 ns/sample (Math.cos 45.7) = 0.147 % of a 48 kHz core = 0.25 Nebel units (R: webaudio.md section 4, 0.581 % = 1 unit); + node 0.06, 3 k-rate params 0.09, tanh table / DC block / RMS tracker ~0.04 -> ~0.45 at L1 for notes up to ~1 kHz. Accuracy needs a step h <= ~0.03 rad (M: with h doubled the bifurcation boundaries move by one 0.025 gamma step at 1760 Hz): 2 substeps to ~500 Hz, 4 to 1 kHz, 8 above -> 0.7-0.9 units for the top octave; cap at 8 and accept drift there. L3 (two coupled systems, stereo) ~0.85. The idea's 0.35 / 0.6 is ~25 % optimistic. Native is impossible (per-sample nonlinear ODE). Contract fits (R: section 10): detune param on the forcing increment, freq k-rate, hoehe -> gamma via the calibrated table in the processor, envelopes native.
soundHeld: Measured (M: duffing_check2/3.js; delta 0.3; 110 and 440 Hz give identical states, strobe-interpolated), default form 0.6 (alpha = -0.6): p1 to gamma 0.16 -> p2 (sub-octave) only 0.165-0.18 -> chaos 0.19-0.27 -> p3 (f/3, sub-twelfth) 0.275-0.325 -> chaos -> p4/p2 slivers at 0.39 -> chaos -> large p1 orbit from 0.475 (+14 dB AC over gamma 0.15). With gamma = 0.15 + 0.44 y this is: y 0-0.03 soft tone, 0.03-0.07 sub-octave, 0.09-0.27 noise, 0.28-0.4 sub-twelfth, 0.45-0.7 noise with one sliver of f/4, >= 0.75 loud tone. Holmes form (alpha = -1): no p2/p4 at 0.005 resolution at all, p1 -> chaos at 0.27 -> p3 sliver 0.365-0.375 -> large p1 at 0.525 with a +12 dB jump. Damping widens the sub-twelfth, not the octave: delta 0.5 gives p2 0.245-0.275, p3 0.305-0.45 (29 % of the travel), chaos 21 %; delta 0.15 shrinks everything (p2 0.125-0.13, chaos 25 %). So the scale invariance holds (same Kippstelle for every note <= 1 kHz), the cascade is real, but the sub-octave windows are 2-6 % of the finger travel and hysteretic (one initial condition tested; coexisting attractors are standard here, A), the broad playable subharmonic is f/3 (an octave and a fifth below, consonant), and 20-45 % of the travel is noise - the surf. As a held note it is distinctive (nothing in Myzel breaks into noise and relocks on a subharmonic), but only with a per-form calibrated y->gamma warp that gives each island ~20 % of travel and parks the finger's rest zone (y 0.3-0.5) on the sub-twelfth, not in chaos. The low-y tone (AC 0.2-0.3) is a dull near-sine sitting on a DC offset of +-0.77 that the DC block turns into thumps when the orbit hops wells; output the velocity (x-dot, no DC, brighter) instead of x. Bebung on the forcing in a chaotic band retriggers states: organic at +-10 ct, erratic at the recogniser's +-70 ct (GA_BEB, APP 9973).
soundBurst: Measured Puls (M: 220 Hz, alpha -0.6, gamma 0.59 -> 0.15 over the gate): the AC level falls from 1.0 (large orbit) through a bumpy chaotic band (0.3-0.8 between 50 and 150 ms) to the soft p1 tone (0.26) that holds through the release: a loud tone that crashes into noise and relocks soft = a real 'Brecher'. It needs gates >= ~160 ms (APP 5980: 0.9 x step = 160-320 ms at 84 bpm; hit() default 0.22 s, APP 5083) and notes >= ~150 Hz (the band needs 15-30 forcing periods); at 1/16 120 bpm (112 ms) on low lanes it is a blip with a noise tail. Velocity sets gamma_max, so a soft hit (vel 0.3) never leaves p1 = a dull sine blip; and the burst starts +14 dB above the resting tone, so the peak must be scaled by ~0.3 at full gamma or the lane jumps out of the mix.
failureModes: Sub-octave windows are 2-6 % of the finger travel and hysteretic; without a calibrated y->gamma warp per form (and delta ~0.5 instead of 0.3) the finger mostly selects noise vs. a sub-twelfth (f/3), not 'Unteroktaven' - rename the promise (Unterklaenge: Oktave, Duodezime, Brandung between) or it disappoints
Level jumps of +12-14 dB at the chaos onset and at the large orbit (M); a 50-ms RMS tracker pumps on a chaotic signal - normalise per state (table) plus a slow tracker
Double-well DC offset (+-0.77) -> well hopping becomes thumps after the DC block; output x-dot (velocity) or a 2nd-order highpass at 0.5 f
Integrator step: boundaries drift above ~1 kHz unless substeps scale with pitch (cost x2-4 at the top), and NaN/clamp resets are audible clicks
Soft hits and y = 0 are a dull near-sine with no transient; the Puls hit needs >= 160 ms gates and notes >= 150 Hz to show the breaker
Hysteresis means the same finger height gives different states depending on the way in (tilt Gestik sweeps become unrepeatable) - document it or add a tiny periodic kick to reset
Bebung at the recogniser's +-70 ct inside a chaotic band is erratic, not organic; scale Bebung depth by state
verdict: Rare, not new: the forced Duffing as an instrument is Tom Mudd's Gutter Synthesis (standalone + Max, 2018) with a browser cousin (Barrel Synth 2022), pitched chaos oscillators exist in Eurorack (Orbit 3, 1 V/oct) and as plugins (Attrattore, Fragua); what is unfound is the note as forcing with the bifurcation parameter under a finger. Worklet-feasible at ~0.45 units (L3 ~0.85), 25 % above the idea's estimate, with pitch-scaled substeps. The simulation (delta 0.3, form 0.6) breaks the headline gesture as written: sub-octave windows are 2-6 % of the finger travel and hysteretic, 20-45 % of the travel is noise, and the broad stable subharmonic is f/3 - so the engine needs a calibrated y->gamma warp per form (delta ~0.5), a renamed promise ('Unterklaenge': Oktave, Duodezime, Brandung between them), velocity output instead of x, and per-state level normalisation of the +12-14 dB jumps. With those it is a genuinely distinctive held note and a convincing 'Brecher' Puls hit at gates >= 160 ms.
